peakRoute: one synchronous real Git metadata child

time.qualification: Conditional cooperative budget, not completion/latency guarantee or hard preemption. Hashing/census/serialization and FS waits are not independently interruptible. One unsafe worker stops the tail; at most one unresolved worker emergency closure adds up to3s nominal polling. Parent collector owns deadline separately.

capture.proposal: KEEP257MiB fail-closed cumulative cap; do not enlarge automatically. Worst-case per-child allowances cannot all be consumed. Raw streams, base64 duplicates, configurations, assessments, references and final multipart documents share cumulative accounting. This is not a claimed size prediction.

working.scope: Owned physical artifacts including retained stages counted conservatively; no disk reservation, whole-checkout census, heap or RSS claim

guards: No loss/integrity/deadline/unknown retirement waiver. Ordinary semantic mismatches aggregate only after existing cleanup and binding gates.
